planningRouteReview.summary: Reviewed Minnesota planning route big-fork-river-highway-6-north-johnson for direct-gauge promotion. No route was added or promoted: MN DNR/public-access evidence remains strong for Highway 6 North WAS01792 at river mile 75.8 to Johnson WAS02708 at river mile 67.5, and Craigsville site 281 is fresh with official bands, but the gauge is upstream at river mile 91.6 rather than inside the reviewed reach. Keep the card planning-only for scored-route accounting until a reach-direct gauge or deliberate proxy-publication policy exists.
evidence: MN DNR Big Fork Map 2 places Highway 6 North at river mile 75.8 and Johnson Landing at river mile 67.5, with Reilly Brook/Reilly Creek context and Johnson watercraft-campsite support inside the reach.
Minnesota public-water-access GIS resolves Highway 6 North / State Hwy 6 (S) WAS01792 at 48.034694214683626, -93.74155634703675 and Johnson WAS02708 at 48.0886283542472, -93.68169266740433.
MN DNR river-level JSON lists Big Fork Craigsville site 281 at river mile 91.6, 47.953553, -93.754329, upstream of the Highway 6 North put-in.
MN DNR site 281 was fresh at 4.85 ft on 2026-08-06 15:00 CDT with official 4.0 / 4.5-8.5 / 9.5 ft interpretation bands, but freshness does not make the upstream gauge direct.
The implemented app record already marks site 281 as proxy for this route, and route-publication keeps proxy routes out of scored Minnesota saturation.
planningRouteReview.nextAction: Continue the Minnesota planning-to-scored audit with otter-tail-river-wannigan-riverside unless a direct Big Fork gauge or approved proxy-publication policy is added.
